title: Islamic Geometric Patterns: Coloring Book for Adults, Bold and Easy
subtitle: 50 Relaxing Tessellation Designs Featuring Zellige Stars, Arabesque Mosaics, and Intricate Tilework for Stress Relief and Mindful Creativity
description:
Discover the timeless beauty of Islamic geometric art through coloring!


This stunning coloring book features 50 unique geometric pattern designs inspired by centuries of Islamic architectural masterpieces. From the intricate zellige tilework of Moroccan mosques to the mesmerizing star patterns of the Alhambra, each page offers a mathematically precise yet deeply relaxing coloring experience.

What's Inside:
• 50 unique Islamic geometric pattern illustrations
• Zellige star mosaics, arabesque scrollwork, tessellations, muqarnas vault patterns, girih designs, and geometric rosettes
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Large 8.5 x 8.5 inch square pages for comfortable coloring
• Bold, easy-to-color outlines perfect for colored pencils, markers, and gel pens

Perfect For:
• Relaxation and stress relief through meditative pattern coloring
• Art lovers and architecture enthusiasts
• Gift for math lovers, geometry fans, and cultural art appreciators
• Mindfulness practice and creative art therapy for all skill levels

Pick up your favorite coloring supplies and lose yourself in the infinite beauty of geometric art!
